name: New London County, CT
findings: New London County has 968 nonprofit organizations. 461 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 377 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, New London County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
